subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's persisted restart-recovery/quarantine contract as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95750?
rationale: The patch appears technically coherent and proof-positive, but it changes durable session recovery state and overlaps an open candidate PR, which requires a maintainer-owned merge-risk and canonical-path choice.

options.title: Accept This PR As Canonical
options.body: Land this branch as the recovery-budget implementation, then close the canonical issue and supersede the remaining overlapping candidate PR.

options.title: Require Supervised Restart Proof
options.body: Ask for one redacted supervised gateway restart proof before merge if file-backed runtime proof is not enough for this availability-sensitive path.

options.title: Pause For Candidate Selection
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer the other candidate's contract, but require equivalent proof and no known guard-order blockers before switching canonical paths.

recommendation.body: Land this branch as the recovery-budget implementation, then close the canonical issue and supersede the remaining overlapping candidate PR.
